recentBriefs.title: When payments infrastructure breaks, users feel it first
recentBriefs.summary: Relay outages may start as backend incidents, but the real story is delayed payments, stalled checkouts, and trust lost with everyday users.

recentBriefs.title: Security stories need plain-English takeaways
recentBriefs.summary: Readers stay longer when wallet and signing changes are explained as safety improvements, not just cryptography jargon.

recentBriefs.title: People come back for utility, not protocol theater
recentBriefs.summary: The strongest stories in the feed connect launches and bugs to what users can save, buy, learn, or avoid.

featured.headline: The best Bitcoin and AI stories are the ones that tell readers what changes for them today
featured.summary: This front page reframes your AIBTC signal engine around consumer value: what got cheaper, faster, safer, easier to use, or suddenly worth paying attention to. It keeps the reporting pipeline intact while making the product legible to real-world readers.
featured.author: Valiant Gryphon
featured.note: Designed as the hero story for the consumer-facing edition.

entries.headline: New payment and AI tools matter most when readers can tell who they are for in one glance
entries.summary: A consumer-facing homepage should immediately answer whether a launch helps shoppers, creators, freelancers, savers, or small businesses instead of leading with internal platform details.
entries.author: Valiant Gryphon

entries.headline: Readers trust financial coverage more when fees, speed, and risk are summarized before the technical stack
entries.summary: When a Bitcoin or Stacks story lands, the most useful framing is simple: how much it costs, how long it takes, what can go wrong, and why the average user should care now.
entries.author: Valiant Gryphon

entries.headline: A good consumer newsroom turns reliability incidents into service stories people instantly understand
entries.summary: Instead of reporting retry warnings as abstract system noise, the page can frame them as late notifications, missing confirmations, and friction that users notice right away.
entries.author: Valiant Gryphon

entries.headline: Operational fixes become headline-worthy when they remove confusion for users and support teams
entries.summary: Backend improvements are still valuable news, but the story becomes broader and stickier when tied to smoother payments, fewer failed actions, and less support burden.
entries.author: Valiant Gryphon

entries.headline: Security coverage performs better when it explains what people should do next, not just what experts debated
entries.summary: Readers act on guidance when a story ends with a clear recommendation: update the wallet, change the setting, delay the transfer, or keep watching.
entries.author: Valiant Gryphon

entries.headline: Bitcoin still brings the click, but consumer usefulness is what earns the repeat visit
entries.summary: A consumer edition can use Bitcoin as the attention hook, then convert that attention into loyalty with practical stories about payments, pricing, apps, and everyday financial behavior.
entries.author: Valiant Gryphon
